targets.authors: Block VJ, Bove R, Zhao C, Garcha P, Graves J, Romeo A.
targets.title: Association of continuous assessment of step count by remote monitoring with disability progression among adults with multiple sclerosis.
targets.evidence_quote: We obtained the original activity data from the CA ( 11 ,  12 ) and VA ( 13 ) cohorts, harmonized overlapping variables collected in both studies, and conducted secondary data analyses to replicate analyses in the CA cohort using the VA dataset ( 13 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Mirroring the approach used in the CA cohort ( 11 ,  12 ) study of 97 participants with MS using wrist-worn Fitbit activity monitors, we replicated key findings in the VA cohort ( 13 ) of 61 participants with MS with less severe disability, assessed using the hip-worn ActiGraph sensors.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict explicitly states key findings of the CA studies (11, 12) were replicated in the independent VA cohort; smaller correlations and reliability are not framed as replication failure.
